Patch Set 9:

Thanks Gunnar and Chinmay. PS9 addresses the mechanical review points; the association / cert-path / Task items remain open pending the spdmd backend (details below).

Addressed in PS9:
- :55 (enums) - dbusTypeToRedfishType / dbusVerificationStatusToRedfish now return the generated component_integrity::ComponentIntegrityType / VerificationStatus enums; the JSON is populated from the typed enum via NLOHMANN_JSON_SERIALIZE_ENUM instead of string literals.
- :455 (long lambda) - the SPDMGetSignedMeasurements callback body is extracted into a named free function afterGetSignedMeasurements() (same pattern as afterHandleComponentIntegrityGet). A thin typed lambda remains at the async_method_call site because that template deduces the D-Bus return signature from the callback parameter types via callable_traits, which a bind_front result can't express.
- :354 (documented in PDI?) - Yes. ComponentIntegrity / IdentityAuthentication / MeasurementSet are defined in phosphor-dbus-interfaces under yaml/xyz/openbmc_project/Attestation/, and the default object path /xyz/openbmc_project/component_integrity was added in merged change 82766.

Already addressed in PS8 (Chinmay's PS6 comments):
- :446 - moved to dbus::utility::async_method_call.
- :581 - the nonce is now validated as a hex-encoded string (std::ranges::all_of) before the D-Bus call; an absent/empty nonce is still permitted.

Still open, gated on the spdmd backend:
- :214 (Gunnar) / :190 / :307 (Chinmay) - agreed the hard-coded inventory-path to Redfish-URI mapping (and the certificate URI, :469) is a stopgap. The design is for spdmd to publish an authenticating association (entity-manager spdm_endpoint.json, 83263) and the certificate object path (spdm 83094), which bmcweb should follow rather than derive here. I'll rework TargetComponentURI and the certificate URI to consume those once the backend interface lands.
- :512 (Chinmay) - agreed, the T1/T2 timeout range makes a Redfish Task the right pattern; I'll convert SPDMGetSignedMeasurements as part of the same backend-dependent rework.

83094 / 83263 are still in review, so I'm keeping the association / cert / Task work as the primary open frontend item and will refresh this change once they merge.

https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/61702 was an attempt before 

Can you update the Redfish.md doc ?
Done
Please add a tested statement.
Done - thanks!
What is Renode?

Renode (renode.io) is an open-source hardware emulator from Antmicro that can boot a full OpenBMC image on an emulated AST2600 with MCTP/PLDM/SPDM device simulation — no physical hardware needed. I've submitted upstream PRs to add AST2600 platform support (renode/renode#888).
Please read Redfish_checklist.md and Testing.md.  at a minimum you've missed the RSV test.

Good catch, thanks. I've now run the Redfish Service Validator against this build on an emulated AST2600. Results: PASS 5784, WARN 353, FAIL 0. The ComponentIntegrity collection endpoint validates clean. I'll update the commit message with the RSV results in the next patchset.

Thanks for the detailed review, Chinmay. These are all good points — I agree the association and cert path handling should come from spdmd rather than being derived in bmcweb.

Specifically on each:
- :190/:307 — will consume the authenticating association from spdmd rather than constructing TargetComponentURI in bmcweb
- :446 — will move to async_method_call
- :469 — will use the /xyz/openbmc_project/certs/devices/{chassis_id}/{cert_id}convention from 83094
- :512 — agreed, the T1/T2 timeout range makes a Task response the right pattern
- :581 — will add hex validation on the nonce

88828 is blocked on the spdmd backend merge (the MCTP/TCP transport chain + your D-Bus interface commits). I'll rework against whatever associations and paths spdmd publishes once that stabilizes. In the meantime I've noted all six points for PS7.
Same as other comment in TargetComponentURI. association should be implemented by spdm daemon.

Chassis is a collection and not a valid target resource URI. We do expect spdm daemon to implement this association(defined here https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/entity-manager/+/83263/1/schemas/spdm_endpoint.json). 

I think if we fail to get the authenticating association it should be treated as an error.
now most of the implementation have moved to use dbus::utility::async_method_call
T1 & T2 timeout values in SPDM can change based on device and it may go beyond seconds including retries. So task is preferred and task response can include the spdm attestation response.
Currently only length is checked, but as per schema it's a hex encoded string, need to make sure string nonce input is hex.
Use enums for these please
Can we not hardcode this? Can we use an assocaition or something ? How are these paths guaranteed ?
Is this documented in PDI  ?

Yes, this is documented here.
https://github.com/openbmc/phosphor-dbus-interfaces/blob/master/yaml/xyz/openbmc_project/Attestation/ComponentIntegrity.interface.yaml#L78
